summary: Rebuilt the #mbr/build slot to the redesigned insight-authoring loop: head with eyebrow 'Monthly Business Review', 'MBR builder · {month}' title and the exact subtitle; a toolbar with a Preview button and an amber 'Lock month' primary and NO theme toggle (builder follows the app's global theme); an amber .local-banner.draft with a warning dot, the 'Draft — changes are saved locally as you go' copy and a 'Last edited {formatDate} · N of M buckets complete' meta; an 'Insights added — N of M KPIs' completion bar counting a KPI done iff its insight is non-empty; bucket cards with a .bucket-head ('N KPIs' + 'N of M insights' sub-count, no per-bucket lock/unlock); and KPI rows (name + purple 'Carried' clock pill when kpi.carried, MetricValueCell value cell, an editable .status-select over the five silhouettes, and an insight textarea that gains .filled when non-empty). Insight edits autosave debounced at 800ms with an immediate flush on blur/before-unload via PUT /__data/snapshots/<id>, stamping Snapshot.lastEditedAt; status edits persist immediately. Removed the old New MBR / Refresh all data / Discard / lockedBy-handle / unlock-amendment UI and the refreshMbr wiring, and ported the draft-banner / progress-wrap / bucket-head / carried-badge / status-select / insight-input.filled CSS into src/styles.css. Updated every existing MbrBuilderView test to the new flow. Full suite green (560) and tsc clean; flip-flop verified by running each edited test file against the parent production code (all red there, green on this tree).

testEdits.reason: Rewrote the core builder tests from the old New MBR / Refresh all / carried-over flow to the ticket's new authoring loop: head + toolbar (Preview + amber Lock month, no theme toggle), amber draft banner, 'Insights added' completion bar, bucket 'N KPIs' + insights sub-count, KPI rows, the Carried pill, filled-insight background, and the 800ms-debounced / blur-flush insight autosave stamping lastEditedAt.

The per-bucket lock/unlock/amendment lifecycle is removed by this ticket; repurposed the file to pin that the old handle-collecting lock modal, unlock/amendment-note flow and per-bucket lock badge/Unlock control are gone, replaced by the single amber 'Lock month' toolbar action (handler wired by a later ticket), and that builder edits never PUT a locked snapshot.

The old toolbar (New MBR / Refresh all / Discard / Lock in MBR snapshot, all .icon-btn) is replaced; rewrote it to assert the redesigned toolbar's exactly-two actions — a Preview .icon-btn and an amber .btn.warn-primary 'Lock month' — their order, type=button, and the absence of any theme toggle.

The editable value <input> is gone (the value cell is now display-only via MetricValueCell) and the status select now carries the token-based .status-select class; updated the CSS-token and behaviour assertions to the .status-select / .insight-input(.filled) controls actually rendered.

The shell was redesigned: bucket headers moved from .bucket-card__head/__name/__count ('N metrics') to .bucket-head/.bucket-name/.bucket-count ('N KPIs') + .bucket-sub, the draft notice is now .local-banner.draft, and the header/toolbar sit in a .head-row; updated the structural assertions accordingly while keeping the shared de-scoped .page-head header check (still shared with the Data model view).

The build-slot dispatch test asserted the removed 'New MBR' button was present; updated it to assert that the redesigned build slot no longer renders that button, keeping the slot-dispatch coverage (all six tests) intact.
